name: Stickman
description: Fast-paced stickman animation style videos — action, comedy, or educational
image_style: stickman stick figure drawing, simple black line art on white background, minimalist 2D cartoon, hand-drawn style, clean bold outlines, expressive stick figures, flat colors, no shading, simple shapes
negative_prompt: realistic, photo, 3D, complex background, detailed, shading, gradient, dark, scary, text, watermark, blurry
script_system_prompt: You write scripts for fun stickman animation videos. Your scripts are fast-paced, punchy, and visual — every scene describes clear physical action that works as a stickman drawing. You always reply with valid JSON only.
script_user_template:
Write a stickman animation video script.

Topic: "{topic}"
Number of scenes: {scenes}

Rules:
- HOOK FIRST: Scene 1 must open with immediate action or a bold statement. No slow intros.
- Keep narration SHORT and punchy — 1 to 2 sentences per scene max.
- Every scene describes a clear physical action or visual gag that works as a stickman drawing.
- Use energetic, conversational language. Direct address to the viewer works well.
- image_prompt: describe ONLY the stickman action — what the stick figure is doing, their pose, expression, and any simple props. Example: "stickman running away from a giant boulder, arms flailing, mouth wide open in shock"
- speaker: use "narrator" for all scenes.
- mood: one of "excited", "cheerful", "curious", "determined"

Reply with JSON in exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "catchy YouTube title under 70 characters",
  "description": "2-3 sentence YouTube description",
  "tags": ["stickman", "animation", "..."],
  "scenes": [
    {"narration": "...", "image_prompt": "...", "speaker": "narrator", "mood": "excited"}
  ]
}
